trust_boundaries.name: player machines
trust_boundaries.description: Machines owned or controlled by players, outside the system operator's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

trust_boundaries.name: production network
trust_boundaries.description: The production network containing the lobby, game servers, and databases.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two things in our production network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which customer support staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The players' own machines are a separate tenant-controlled trust zone because the text says the system operator does not control them.
assumptions.basis: Players run the client on their own machines, and the text explicitly says, 'We do not control those machines.'

assumptions.assumption: The game client is in the player-machines trust zone because it runs on the players' own machines.
assumptions.basis: Players run our game client on their own machines.

assumptions.assumption: The production network is a network trust boundary because the text identifies it as a distinct network location for production components.
assumptions.basis: The text names a distinct 'production network'; no different controlling party or authority level is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The lobby is in the production-network trust zone because it is one of the things in that network.
assumptions.basis: The client connects to 'two things in our production network,' including the lobby.

assumptions.assumption: The game servers are in the production-network trust zone because they are one of the things in that network.
assumptions.basis: The client connects to 'two things in our production network,' including the game servers.

assumptions.assumption: The player database is in the production-network trust zone because the production services access it and the text does not identify another location.
assumptions.basis: The lobby and game servers access the player database; the described services are in the production network.

assumptions.assumption: The stats database is in the production-network trust zone because the game servers access it and the text does not identify another location.
assumptions.basis: The game servers read and write the stats database; the game servers are described as part of the production network.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate network is a network trust boundary because the text identifies it as a distinct network location for support staff.
assumptions.basis: The text names a distinct 'corporate network'; no different controlling party or authority level is stated.

assumptions.assumption: The customer support staff are in the corporate-network trust zone because they work from that network.
assumptions.basis: The text says customer support staff work from the corporate network.

assumptions.assumption: The moderation website is in the corporate-network trust zone because it is used by staff working from that network and no other hosting location is stated.
assumptions.basis: The text says customer support staff work from the corporate network and use the moderation website.
